session_turns: Finally said goodbye to the old pickup — I picked up a 1998 Volvo V70 wagon last weekend to replace it.
It's got 210k on the clock but the thing drives like a couch on wheels, honestly love it.
Only annoyance is the tailgate strut is shot so I prop it with a broom handle.
chain.state_span: I picked up a 1998 Volvo V70 wagon last weekend to replace it

session_turns: Well, the head gasket went, so the wagon is gone and I'm now driving a 2016 Mazda3 hatchback.
Traded it in at a lot off the highway, got less than I hoped but I wasn't going to sink another two grand into a coolant leak.
The Mazda is so much quieter on the freeway, my ears are grateful.
Also it has bluetooth, which feels like time travel for me.
chain.state_span: I'm now driving a 2016 Mazda3 hatchback

session_turns: Big news: with the baby coming we needed room, so the hatchback got sold and we drove home a 2021 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid on Saturday.
My sister came with us to the dealer and basically negotiated for me, she's ruthless.
Getting like 39 mpg around town which softened the blow of the payment.
chain.state_span: we drove home a 2021 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid on Saturday

session_turns: Okay, I caved on the minivan thing — swapped the SUV for a 2019 Honda Odyssey minivan yesterday.
Two car seats plus a stroller plus my in-laws visiting made the decision for me.
The sliding doors alone are worth it in a tight parking garage.
I have officially become the guy who says 'you should see the cargo space'.
chain.state_span: swapped the SUV for a 2019 Honda Odyssey minivan yesterday
